economic_unit.unit: USD notional of settled swaps per UTC calendar day on intents.near
economic_unit.our_measure: half gross participant notional: for each successful execute_intents receipt, for each (account, intent_hash) take the larger of priced inflow and priced outflow, sum over participants and divide by two. One two-party swap of 100 USDC against NEAR counts 100 USD once.
economic_unit.scope: token_diff events emitted by intents.near in receipts with an explicit successful execution status; all chains and assets that appear in those events; no deposits, withdrawals or transfers
economic_unit.day_boundary: UTC; a sampled window is attributed to the planned UTC day
economic_unit.prices: DefiLlama coins daily USD prices (CoinGecko ids from the committed 1Click registry), stablecoins at par, at most seven-day forward fill; unknown or unpriced assets contribute zero
economic_unit.reference: DefiLlama dexs/near-intents dailyVolume = SUM(volume_amount_usd) FROM dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics per date_at (adapter source: DefiLlama/dimension-adapters dexs/near-intents/index.ts). The dataset is a curated Dune table maintained for NEAR's metrics; whether volume_amount_usd is one-sided or two-sided notional is not published, so the two measures are compared, not assumed identical.
economic_unit.shared_origin: DefiLlama does not compute this series itself; it queries Dune. Every public reference found derives from NEAR's own metrics datasets (Dune dune.near.*, the ClickHouse table behind near-intents.org, revenue.near.org volumeUsd), so none is of independent origin; the Dune series also covers confidential intents, which emit no public token_diff logs and are therefore outside what any on-chain log extraction can observe (see reference_definition).

adapter.query: SUM(CAST(volume_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) FROM dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics WHERE date_at = day
adapter.notes: no methodology comments in the adapter; flagged isExpensiveAdapter; start 2024-11-05

dataset_maintainer.claim: the dune.near.dataset_near_intents_* tables are uploaded by NEAR (the DefiLlama issue #10317 waits for 'near's datasets' to catch up when fee rows are missing)
dataset_maintainer.kind: observed in a public issue, not confirmed by NEAR documentation

confidential_intents.claim: the Dune all-time volume includes confidential intents, which the ClickHouse table behind near-intents.org excludes
confidential_intents.kind: estimate: a cumulative share from a secondary source, applied here to the comparison period as if constant; the period share is unknown
confidential_intents.implication: confidential intents do not emit public token_diff logs, so they are structurally outside our on-chain measure while inside the reference

other_references.revenue.near.org: publishes volumeUsd per day equal to the Dune figure (same origin); no API or download
other_references.near-intents.org: ClickHouse near_intents_metrics.intents_external_metrics, public intents only; no public API
other_references.Intents Explorer API: 1Click swaps only, JWT required, 1 request per 5 s: not a protocol-wide volume source
other_references.Flipside ez_intents: independent indexer of intents.near logs (one row per token_diff leg, USD per leg); requires an account; not accessed

reference_definition.one_or_two_sided: not published anywhere found; the comparison keeps both readings

temporal_coverage.reading: two 50-block windows observe about 0.07% of a day's blocks; the 15:00 UTC window carries several times the 03:00 volume, so the day mean is sensitive to which hours are observed. The intraday block measures this directly where available

unpriced_assets_top.reason: price snapshot polygon-ecosystem-token is empty (DefiLlama coins API returned no history)
price snapshot sweatcoin is empty (DefiLlama coins API returned no history)
price snapshot berachain-bera is empty (DefiLlama coins API returned no history)
asset id not in the committed 1Click registry
price snapshot arbitrum is empty (DefiLlama coins API returned no history)
asset id not in the committed 1Click registry

two_sided_pricing_check.reading: near 1.0 means daily prices and decimals are consistent across the two legs of the same intent

valuation.reading: an account-intent is valued by whichever side is priced, so unpriced legs lose value only when neither side is priced; the count above bounds that loss in account-intents, not in USD, which is unobservable without a price

per_token_net_relative_to_gross.reading: diffs within a receipt balance per token up to rounding dust; fees are not inside token_diff

route_reconstruction.reading: if the reference counted both sides of every swap, our ratio would double; if it counted only user legs, it would move by the user-side/half-gross factor. These bounds are definitional, not evidence about the reference

residual.reading: identified components: definitional (one- versus two-sided notional, unresolved), coverage of the reference (confidential intents are inside the Dune series and outside any public log; cumulative share from a secondary source, an estimate) and intraday coverage (measured on three days, checked on three more). The factor to parity that remains after the confidential share and the measured intraday bias is unexplained and is reported as such, not attributed to missing large trades. The two-sided reading and the intraday factor are separate hypotheses: that their combination exceeds parity shows the two readings cannot both be taken at face value together, but it does not identify which one overstates, and estimation error and unidentified components remain

holdout.rule: sampled days with a positive reference value are sorted chronologically; even positions calibrate, odd positions validate; declared before evaluation

tolerance.justification: covers measured pricing dispersion (a few percent), not coverage or definitional gaps

holdout.verdict: validation days outside the declared tolerance: the on-chain estimate does not reproduce the reference level

intraday.selection_rule: sampled days with both fixed windows usable and a DefiLlama reference; pick the highest-volume day, the day closest to the 2026 median and the day closest to the 2025 median; declared before fetching
intraday.reading: Factor > 1 means the two fixed windows under-represent the day's hourly mean; even 24 hourly windows observe about 1,200 of ~150,000 blocks, so this measures the intraday expansion error, not a complete day. The median across days is used for the correction because a single hourly window can carry most of a day's sampled volume and dominate the mean
intraday.scope: the days were selected by reference volume and are not a representative sample of the history; the factor is a sensitivity and is not applied to the declared estimator. It is checked on separately selected validation days (see intraday_validation)

rule.declared: 2026-11-07, after the motivating days were measured and before any validation block was fetched
rule.selection: sampled days with both fixed windows usable and a DefiLlama reference, excluding the three motivating days, sorted chronologically; take the days at positions floor(n/4), floor(n/2) and floor(3n/4)
rule.aggregation: median of the per-day fixed-window bias factors over the validation days
rule.acceptance: the motivating median is considered supported if the validation median lies within x0.5 to x2 of it; the range reflects the day-level dispersion already observed on the motivating days (2.0 to 7.7)
rule.not_a_correction_of_the_estimator: the declared estimator stays uncorrected; the factor is published as a sensitivity in either outcome

intraday_validation.unbounded_factor_reading: on these days the two fixed windows observed no volume while other hours did, so the factor is unbounded rather than missing; the verdict is required to hold both excluding them and treating them as infinite (which moves the median to the largest defined factor)
intraday_validation.verdict: validation days reproduce the motivating factor within the declared x0.5-x2 range (also when the day with an unbounded factor is treated as infinite)

rule.declared: 2026-11-07, before any block of this design was read
rule.day: the chronologically middle of the three validation days (selected earlier by position, not by volume): 2025-11-14
rule.design: systematic sample of every 40th block from the first block at or after 00:00 UTC to the last block before 00:00 UTC of the next day, with a random start offset in [0, 40) drawn from seed 20261107; about 2.5% of the day's blocks, spread over the whole day instead of 24 fifty-block windows
rule.estimator: day volume = sum of the sampled blocks' half-gross participant notional x step; design-based standard error from successive differences
rule.what_it_establishes: whether the day's total under our definition is compatible with the reference once intraday selection is replaced by an even spread with a quantified sampling error; one day, so it bounds the sampling component for that day, not the global total

systematic_day.status: pending: systematic day not fetched yet (make blocks-systematic-day)

not_possible_here: complete-day extracts (FastNear public rate limit ~0.35 blocks/s; a NEAR day has ~150,000 blocks)

a reference of independent origin: every public series found (DefiLlama, revenue.near.org, near-intents.org) derives from NEAR's own metrics datasets; the only independent indexer found (Flipside ez_intents) requires an account
the published definition of volume_amount_usd in dune.near.dataset_near_intents_metrics (one- or two-sided)
the share of confidential intents in the comparison period (only a cumulative share from a secondary source is available)
